THE OPERATOR AGREES THAT THIS CHARGE MAY BE APPLIED. AN INCIDENT 
REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED TO THE SWEDISH CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY.

FLIGHTS, POLICE, AMBULANCE AND LIFE-SAVING OPERATIONS, THE COAST 
GUARD, SEARCH AND RESCUE (SAR) OPERATIONS, AND RESCUE SERVICES IN

FROM THE RESTRICTIONS AND MAY TRANSIT THE AREA UPON OBTAINING
